body.about: Every board item placed at the lowest altitude that can do it, by the altitudes of execution in action (abp/tools/altitudes.mjs): A0 planned, three A2 loops each ran A1 calls on an open-weight model until valid, A0 verified every signature and merged; architect.1 (A3) started the loops. Each unit signed with a key that existed only while it ran. A model's placement is evidence, not a decision.
